scene_description: A vibrant and cheerful supermarket designed in a chibi style, featuring colorful shelves stocked with various food items and playful decorations. The atmosphere is lively and inviting, perfect for a mobile app experience.
visual_style: Chibi style, bright colors, simple shapes, playful and happy mood

objects.name: Grocery Shelf
objects.visual_description: A tall, colorful shelf filled with various food items like snacks and canned goods. Provides storage and display for products.

objects.name: Checkout Counter
objects.visual_description: A small, cute checkout counter with a cash register and space for bags. Serves as the payment area.

objects.name: Shopping Cart
objects.visual_description: A small, chibi-style shopping cart with a bright color scheme. Used for carrying groceries around the store.

objects.name: Fruit Stand
objects.visual_description: A colorful display stand filled with various fruits like apples, bananas, and oranges. Adds freshness to the scene.

objects.name: Snack Rack
objects.visual_description: A small rack showcasing a variety of snacks in bright packaging. Attracts customers with its vibrant colors.

objects.name: Milk Cooler
objects.visual_description: A chibi-style cooler filled with milk cartons and juice boxes. Provides a refreshing beverage option for shoppers.
